notes.title: NEW MENU PLUS ENITITY UPDATE
notes.content:
A new menu has been added with full controller support and expanded options for adjusting graphics, video settings, color, and more. We've also introduced a Level Select feature, allowing players to explore all levels without any entities—perfect for those who want to freely explore the game world.

Additional updates include:

A voiced Game Intro, now featuring a voice actor.

Various bug fixes and map changes.

Zoom functionality has been improved to zoom in more quickly.
